AS BUILT

Nine rows of chips, one knob whose meaning changes silently, and MUTATE.

Nothing on this card makes a sound. You pick a word you don't know and a tag you can't hear, then commit a file write to find out.

PROPOSAL · AT REST

The pairing is the hero: both parents named, drawn, and audible before anything happens.

The partner picker collapses to one line — that's the room the waveforms live in. The move carries a result-line; the knob carries its meaning.

PROPOSAL · HEARD

HEAR renders the result and plays it — no write. The third waveform is what you'd be keeping.

KEEP IT only lights once you've heard it. The destructive step is now the last one, not the first.

PROPOSAL · THE WAY IN

Opened on a pad with no partner chosen. DRIFT is the whole card: the crate picks, you say how far.

Choosing a partner by hand is still there, folded under one line.

THE SIX MOVES

The copy, as a sheet. Each line says what you get, not what the DSP does — and names the knob in the same breath.

The words themselves don't change: they're in the CLI, the recipe and the lineage.
